title: The Other Keeper
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 7: The Other Keeper. After walking a long way alone across the slow-turning world, the Keeper meets another light — a keeper already here. It does not speak; it sings. Through a call-and-response that harmonizes, it welcomes him and introduces the world: every soul is a note, some bright, some low, some still lost in the dark — and we do not fix them, we help them find who they harmonize with. Then the two walk on together.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #storytelling
